text:
jin: Quick Q — proposing default retry behavior changes in the Go + Node SDKs for handling 429/5xx and streaming. TL;DR: non-streaming -> full-jitter exp backoff (base 200ms, max 10s), respect Retry-After; streaming -> prefer resume tokens/offsets, avoid replaying entire request; auth (401) -> single refresh+retry. Also suggest clients opt-in for automatic retries on non-idempotent write endpoints or require idempotency-key. Thoughts? cc @sam @maria @alex

sam: +1 to full-jitter for normal requests. keep max attempts small (4-6). for 429 specifically, if Retry-After header present, use it as min delay. otherwise backoff. simple and predictable.

maria: Agree. Small nit: recommend jitter strategy = random_between(0, backoff) (aka "full jitter" from AWS doc). example pseudo for go:
```go
func backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
  base := 200 * time.Millisecond
  max := 10 * time.Second
  exp := min(max, base * (1<<attempt))
  return time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(exp)))
}
```
Make sure to seed RNG once.

alex: For streams: add a lightweight resume token header on server side (Resume-After/Resume-Token). client should attempt resume up to N times with short backoff (200-500ms) and then surface an unrecoverable error. Replaying full request for long-running generation causes duplicated outputs / side effects.

ravi: Important: for endpoints that mutate state (uploads, billing events), default SDK should NOT auto-retry without idempotency-key. Offer a helper that generates stable idempotency keys when callers opt into "at-least-once-safe" mode. Otherwise risk double-charges.

sam: On 5xx: treat as transient; retry with exp-jitter like above. On 429: treat as rate-limited, backoff more aggressively and surface metrics (headers, last-retry-delay) so app teams can adjust client-side quotas.

maria: Also: auth refresh races — if you see 401, perform token-refresh once and retry. Do not do unbounded retries if refresh keeps failing. Add circuit-breaker / token-refresh cooldown (eg 30s) to avoid thundering refreshes.

jin: Good call on telemetry. We should emit retry_reason (429/5xx/timeout/auth), attempt_count, last_delay for every request. Makes debugging customer-side spikes much easier.

dev-bot: deploy: go-sdk#release/0.31.0 preview build passed on main — include retry changes in changelog? :white_check_mark:

alex: +1 to changelog. also add a short example in the streaming README showing resume header and client-side resume pseudo.

maria: One more language note: Node streams often can't be rewound; prefer server-side resume support or buffering small windows. Python/Go can more easily reconnect with a resume token. Document language-specific caveats.

jin: OK—plan: implement full-jitter default with base 200ms, max 10s, max attempts 6 for non-stream calls; for streams add resume-token support + 3 resume attempts with 200-500ms spacing; require idempotency-key opt-in for mutating endpoints (helper generator included). I'll open a PR with RFC + snippets. who wants to review?

sam: I can review the RFC tomorrow.

maria: I'll take the resume-token API docs (README + examples).

ravi: I'll add the idempotency helper and tests for double-submit safety.

alex: :thumbsup: happy to help with Node caveats.

jin: thanks all — I'll drop the RFC link when it's up.
